question.text: Will the AAA national average price of regular gasoline be below $4.05 per gallon on November 13, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on the AAA national average retail price for regular gasoline, in U.S. dollars per gallon, reported by AAA for November 13, 2026 at https://gasprices.aaa.com/ (the "Regular" figure labelled "Current Avg." with a "Price as of" date of 11/13/26; the same figure displayed as the "Yesterday Avg." on a later day counts as well). It resolves Yes if that value is strictly below $4.05 per gallon (a value of $4.0499 or lower resolves Yes; a value of $4.05 or higher resolves No), and No otherwise. If AAA does not publish a national average for November 13, 2026, the first national average AAA publishes for a later date is used instead. If gasprices.aaa.com is unavailable or no such figure is ever published, the question resolves using the AAA national average for regular gasoline for November 13, 2026 as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions); if no such value can be established, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: Only AAA's national average for the "Regular" grade is used; mid-grade, premium, diesel, E85 and individual state averages do not count.

research:
## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: AAA's national average for regular is **$4.1694**. The "Yesterday" figure (11/1) is $4.1732, a week ago $4.2858, a month ago $4.3961 and a year ago $3.0361. [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/)
- Recent AAA daily prints: 10/29 $4.2258, 10/30 $4.2046, 10/31 $4.1837, 11/1 $4.1732, 11/2 $4.1694. Daily drops have shrunk: about 2.1, 1.0, 0.4 cents. (10/31 is from news reports. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/articles/gas-prices-10-31-26-150733811.html), [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/))

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. To get below $4.05 on 11/13, the average must fall about **12 cents more in 11 days**, roughly 1.1 cents a day. The last two days averaged only about 0.7 cents a day.
- 2026-10-31: The average has not been below $4 since late July. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/articles/gas-prices-10-31-26-150733811.html)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-02: Brent fell about 3.2% to $109.75 and WTI to about $100.69, on hopes for Qatari-led talks to end the Iran war. Brent had **closed October at a six-month high** after "strong gains" in the last week of October. KCM Trade warned Brent could reach $120 if Iran rhetoric escalates after the midterms. ING said the key question is whether the market keeps pricing in a geopolitical risk premium or starts to unwind it. OPEC+ left December output targets unchanged. [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/energy/oil-prices-ease-3-on-optimism-for-qatari-led-talks-on-ending-iran-war-3009376), [UNN](https://unn.ua/en/news/oil-fell-15percent-to-dollar10256-per-barrel-amid-talks-to-end-the-war-with-iran)
- 2026-11-01: President Trump called high fuel prices a "small price to pay." AAA: gasoline $4.17, diesel $6.30. [DW](https://www.dw.com/es/el-presidente-donald-trump-elude-toda-responsabilidad-por-altos-precios-de-la-gasolina-en-estados-unidos/a-79825128)
- 2026-10-31: AAA $4.18, down 9 cents on the week and 25 cents on the month. High crude is keeping prices from falling faster. [Yahoo](https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/articles/gas-prices-10-31-26-150733811.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/31/trump-gas-diesel-price-midterm-election.html)
- 2026-10-22: Brent was above $112, its highest since May. De Haan: "Gasoline will not fall below $4/gal prior to the midterms." Denton Cinquegrana (Dow Jones Energy) said refined product supply is still constrained by damaged refineries and higher transport costs, and that prices would fall slowly even after a peace deal. He also said seasonal factors (winter blend, lower demand) favor declines. [ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Business/gas-prices-fall-below-4-gallon-midterms-experts/story?id=137476005)
- A search result describing a De Haan post saying prices would be "under $4 within a week or two" is actually from **April 8, 2026**, during an earlier ceasefire. It does not apply now. [National Desk](https://thenationaldesk.com/news/americas-news-now/gas-diesel-prices-could-drop-within-days-as-us-iran-war-ceasefire-holds-gasbuddy-oil-analyst-patrick-de-haan-says)

## 4. Base rates and trend
- Weekly declines: about 6 cents (10/15 to 10/22), 5 cents (10/22 to 10/29), and 11.6 cents in the 7 days to 11/2. The month-over-month decline is about 22.7 cents, roughly 0.75 cents a day on average.
- At the 30-day average pace (about 0.75 c/day), the 11/13 value would be about $4.09. At the 7-day pace (about 1.65 c/day) it would be about $3.99. At the latest 2-day pace (about 0.7 c/day) it would be about $4.09.
- The late-October rise in crude (Brent at a six-month high) would normally reach retail with a lag of about 1 to 2 weeks. That could slow or stall the decline in early to mid November. The 11/2 crude drop works the other way. Pump prices typically "fall more slowly than they rise." [ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Business/gas-prices-fall-below-4-gallon-midterms-experts/story?id=137476005)
- EIA's monthly average for October 2026 was $4.310. [EIA](https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/leafhandler.ashx?n=pet&s=emm_epmr_pte_nus_dpg&f=m)
- I could not find current RBOB (wholesale gasoline) futures prices.

## 5. Other forecasts (Kalshi and Polymarket, as of 2026-11-02 09:50 UTC)
- Kalshi, "How low will US gas prices get in Nov 2026": Below $4.05 at **0.48**, below $4.10 at 0.60, below $4.00 at 0.38, below $4.15 at 0.73. This asks about the monthly minimum at any point in November, so it sets an upper bound for an 11/13 point estimate. Some odd non-monotonic pricing ($3.95 at 0.45 vs $4.00 at 0.38) suggests thin liquidity.
- Kalshi, Nov 30 level: Above $4.00 at 0.56, above $4.10 at 0.36. This implies about a 44% chance of being at or below $4.00 on Nov 30.
- Kalshi, Election Day (11/3): Above $4.15 at about 0.77, above $4.20 at 0.03. This is consistent with a value around $4.16 to $4.17.
- Polymarket, 11/2: the $4.16 to $4.1699 bucket was at 0.99, which matches the AAA figure of $4.1694.
- I found no Metaculus or expert forecast specifically for 11/13.

## 6. Upcoming events before 11/13
- 2026-11-03: US midterm elections. Analysts flagged a possible escalation over Iran afterward, with Brent possibly reaching $120. [Arab News](https://arabnews.com/energy/oil-prices-ease-3-on-optimism-for-qatari-led-talks-on-ending-iran-war-3009376)
- Ongoing: Iran-Qatar talks on ending the war. A deal would cut crude prices, but the effect on retail would lag. A collapse of the talks would push crude up.
- 2026-11-04 and 11-12 (approximately): EIA weekly petroleum status reports on gasoline inventories. EIA's weekly retail gasoline price update was due on 11/3.
- 2026-11-10: EIA's November Short-Term Energy Outlook. The October edition put 4Q26 Brent at $105.
- AAA weekly releases, typically on Thursdays (11/5 and 11/12).

## 4. Base rates and trend
- AAA weekly averages: $4.41 (Oct 1), $4.33 (Oct 15), $4.27 (Oct 22), $4.22 (Oct 29), $4.17 (Nov 2). That is about 5-6 cents a week, or 0.8 cents a day on average over October. Eleven more days at the October pace would give about 9 cents, leaving the average near $4.08. Matching the latest 7-day pace (1.66 c/day) would give about $3.99. [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/national-average-dips-following-record-setting-september/), [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/)
- Typical variation: in normal years, 11-day changes in the national average in November usually stay within ±5-10 cents. Moves of 12 cents or more usually need a sustained drop in crude or wholesale prices. As a comparison from the 2022 shock (from memory, not verified), the average stalled or rose slightly in early November before falling sharply later in the month.
- The 2026 peak was about $4.48 in May. [LendingTree](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/study/us-gas-prices/)

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) The outcome will be known in about 11 days, when AAA posts its November 13, 2026 figure. For Yes, the AAA national regular average dated 11/13/26 must be $4.0499 or lower. From $4.1694 on 11/2, that is a drop of about 12 cents in 11 days, roughly 1.1 cents a day.

(b) If nothing changed, the average would stay around $4.17 and the question would resolve No. Even a slow continued slide of about 0.5 to 0.7 cents a day ends near $4.09 to $4.11, which is still No.

(c) Base rate: in autumn, after winter-blend switchover, national averages typically fall about 0.5 to 1 cent a day. Drops of 12 or more cents in 11 days happen, but mostly when crude is falling. With crude flat or rising, I estimate such a drop happens about 25 to 30% of the time. Starting base rate: about 30%.

(d) Evidence:
- For Yes:
  - The 7-day pace to 11/2 was about 1.65 cents a day, which would reach about $3.99.
  - Brent fell 3.2% on 11/2 on hopes for Qatari-led peace talks.
  - Seasonal factors (winter blend, lower demand) favor declines.
  - Kalshi puts the November monthly minimum below $4.05 at 0.48.
- For No:
  - Daily declines are clearly slowing: 2.1, 1.0 and 0.4 cents through 11/2.
  - Brent closed October at a six-month high after strong late-October gains. That would pass through to retail with a 1 to 2 week lag, landing right in this window.
  - Refined product supply is still constrained by damaged refineries (Cinquegrana, 10/22).
  - Prices "fall more slowly than they rise."
  - The 30-day pace (0.75 cents a day) points to about $4.09.
  - The Kalshi 0.48 covers the minimum over the whole month, so it is an upper bound for an 11/13 point value.

(e) Scenarios:
- No: Late-October crude strength feeds through to retail. Talks stall after the midterms and Brent holds near $110. The decline flattens to about 0.3 to 0.6 cents a day and the average sits near $4.10 to $4.13 on 11/13.
- Yes: The Qatari-led talks progress and Brent slides toward $100. Wholesale gasoline drops and retailers keep cutting at about 1.2 or more cents a day, putting the average at about $4.03 on 11/13.

(f) The closest market is Kalshi's monthly-minimum contract at 48%. Below $4.05 on 11/13 is a strict subset of that, since much of the path to a low November minimum falls in late November. Kalshi's Nov 30 market implies about 44% for at or below $4.00 by month-end. Back-solving to a mid-month point, I get roughly 28 to 33%. The decelerating daily drops and the lagged late-October crude spike push me slightly lower. The 11/2 crude decline partly offsets this. Net, I move from about 30% to about 26%.

Probability: 26%
